numeric_match.predicate: abs(actual - golden) <= max( abs + rel * abs(golden), print_ulp[field_kind] )

strict_match.predicate: abs(actual - golden) <= max( abs + rel * abs(golden), print_ulp[field_kind] )
strict_match.role: diagnostic only, never a pass/fail gate

exact_textual_match: diagnostic only, never a pass/fail gate
numerical_error_definition: max over F6/F12 fields of abs(actual - golden) / (1 + abs(golden))
rationale: 1e-6 relative absorbs FMA contraction under the frozen build recipes and the per-runtime differences in log/exp/sqrt implementations across 10 toolchains; it is far tighter than any genuine algorithmic error, which shows up at 1e-2 or larger in every failure mode observed in the reference algorithms. The print_ulp floor exists because the output contract quantizes to a fixed number of decimal places: two correct implementations may legitimately print adjacent last digits, and that difference must never be scored as an error.
relationship_to_micro_tolerance: 06_micro_workloads.md section 2.4 freezes |delta| <= max(1e-9*|expected|, 1e-12) for single-pass micro kernels printed at 17 significant digits. ALGO-TOL-1 is deliberately looser because these workloads iterate (1000 SVM sweeps, 60 EM iterations, 150 LightGrad steps) and because their output contract quantizes to fixed decimal places. 00_cross_language_constraints.md section C-2 provides that the tolerance is recorded per workload; this is that record.
